destination.name: Jiaxing
destination.tagline: A canal city on the Shanghai to Hangzhou line, centred on South Lake and old streets
destination.description: Jiaxing is a prefecture city between Shanghai and Hangzhou, built on canals and lakes. South Lake holds an islet with the Misty Rain Tower, where the Communist Party's first congress ended aboard a boat in 1921. Yuehe Street, a canal-side quarter of teahouses and a zongzi museum, and the city museum with its Majiabang prehistoric culture galleries round out a short visit. The canal town of Wuzhen, in the same prefecture, lies about 25 km west.

goodToKnow.title: Day trip from Shanghai
goodToKnow.detail: The historic centre is under an hour by train from Shanghai, and South Lake is a long-popular day trip.

goodToKnow.title: Canal towns nearby
goodToKnow.detail: Jiaxing prefecture also holds the canal towns Wuzhen and Xitang, both popular with visitors.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Mild, clear weather in {months} suits lake walks. Summers are humid, with June rains.
